text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Yukino Bijin...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Yukino Bijin's line of sight to
find a claw
machine filled with a popular
type of Umamusume
plushies called
Cuties.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's full of Cuties now! The prizes were
completely
diff'rent last time I was here.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Golly... The prizes in the claw machines
back
home've been the same my whole
life.
choice_data_list: Things can change pretty quickly, after all.
Things can change pretty quickly, you know.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I guess that mean if there's someth'n I
want, I've
gotta snatch it up straight
away!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Well, they're just so charm'n!
Don't you
think? I never really saw any
back home.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-you will?! Well, I think I'll have t'take
you up on
that offer!
choice_data_list: Shall I get it for you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
